content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text treats the Romans 1:3 collision as underdetermined because paternity lacks an explicit textual resolution, so it is testing for an expressly stated resolution rather than weighing chain against chain by footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "whether “without explicit textual resolution” is a legitimate chain-by-footing conclusion or a forbidden stating-verse requirement; the two readings are that the judge weighed the chains’ footing versus that the judge demanded an explicit verse stating the resolution.", "why": "Because the judge labels the matter underdetermined for lack of explicit textual resolution of paternity, it applies the retired stating-verse test rather than weighing the two chains by footing."}
